items.context: Two friends planning a night out

script.speaker: man
script.text: Shall we go to the jazz concert on Saturday?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I'd love to, but I'll be at my sister's wedding. They're also playing on Sunday, though.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Sunday's sold out, I checked this morning. There's a late show on Friday, mind you.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Friday works for me. Could you book the tickets?

script.speaker: man
script.text: Of course. I'll do it tonight.

items.question: When will they go to the concert?
options: On the evening before the wedding

explanation.en: Saturday is the wedding and Sunday is sold out, so they choose the late show on Friday, the evening before the wedding.
explanation.es: El sábado hay boda y el domingo está agotado, así que van el viernes.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Hi Dan, it's Lucy. Sorry to miss you. About Saturday, I know I said I'd cook, but my sister's arriving early, so could we have the dinner at your place instead? I'd bring the dessert and the wine. Don't worry about the starter, Jack's already making soup. Ring me when you can.

items.question: What is Lucy asking Dan to do?
options: Have the dinner at his home

explanation.en: Lucy asks politely if the dinner can be at Dan's place. She brings the dessert herself and Jack makes the soup.
explanation.es: Lucy pregunta si la cena puede ser en casa de Dan. El postre lo trae ella y la sopa la hace Jack.
